source_of_truth.accepted_paper: AwareML: Transparent, Controllable, and Sustainable Streaming AutoML (CIKM 2026 demo)

phase10_decisions.decision: Keep Phases 0-9 as the completed engineering foundation. Journal reviewer-driven work starts at Phase 10.
The four fixed objective labels for the NL benchmark are Accuracy, Runtime, Energy, and CO2.
The NL objective-selection task is multi-label objective-set inference. Continuous weights are not the primary Phase-12 benchmark output.
The roadmap phrase '23 meta-training datasets' is resolved as a wording inconsistency. Canonical architecture is 47 development/meta-training datasets plus 23 final held-out evaluation datasets.

The exact identities of the 23 held-out datasets are currently absent from the repository manifest. They must not be invented. Final held-out evaluation remains blocked until identities are authoritatively recovered and frozen.
Journal objective-selection LLM is LLaMA 3 8B through Ollama with exact tag llama3:8b, exact model digest, recorded Ollama version, deterministic generation options, and no silent fallback.
Phase 10 freezes the target prompt/schema for Phase 11 but does not modify the current Phase-7 Copilot behavior.
The 705 meta-logs remain recommender evidence. They are not Copilot objective-selection benchmark data.
